plan.bootstrap: 2000 noncircular moving blocks, seed 271027; conditional on saved fitted models, not whole fitting process
plan.evaluation: 2026-01-01 through 2026-07-31, monthly past-90-day fitting; label end <= fit cutoff.
plan.features: Current return/past 60-minute RMS bins [-1,-.25,.25,1]; trades/past60 mean bins [.5,1.5]; minute taker imbalance bins [-.6,-.2,.2,.6]; last10second imbalance bins [-.3,.3].
plan.gate: Primary Brier improves >=1% vs both frequency and price; paired 7-day block bootstrap 95% lower bound >0; no log-loss degradation; positive gain in >=5 of 7 months for both comparators.
plan.hypothesis: Minute and last-ten-second taker flow predict short-horizon direction beyond price/activity regimes.
plan.models: Smoothed global class frequency; 15 price/activity cells; 75 price/activity/flow cells; 225 cells including last10second flow. Hierarchical Dirichlet prior weights 100,100,150; no selection.
plan.primary: seconds model, 5-minute horizon, 1-minute delay; all other runs diagnostic
plan.sampling: UTC anchors every horizon minutes; complete 62-minute context and full target path; no overlap within each run; no trade/executable-price claim.
plan.source: Existing BTCUSDT one-second OHLCV, 2025-09-01 through 2026-07-31; never order-book events.
plan.status: Historical falsification on previously inspected price periods; no pristine or prospective holdout claim.
plan.storage: Reuse existing archives and environment; estimated outputs <200MiB, no downloads or installations.
plan.target: Three classes: negative, exactly zero, positive terminal return; retain all ties.
